title: Three distances, one function
statement_md:
Write `distance(a, b, kind="l2")` returning the distance between two 1-D sequences.

- `"l1"`: sum of absolute differences
- `"l2"`: square root of the sum of squared differences (the default)
- `"linf"`: the largest absolute difference
- raise `ValueError` when the lengths differ or `kind` is unknown
- always return a `float`, and do not mutate the inputs
starter:
